description: What the NC Medicaid State Excluded Providers List covers and how current it is: total rows, how many carry an NPI vs. an atypical (non-NPI) ID, the distinct exclusion reasons published (FEDERAL, STATE, OIG, and combinations), and the oldest/newest exclusion effective dates. Notes that this is a CURRENT SNAPSHOT (not an ever-excluded history) — a reinstated provider simply disappears from the next monthly file. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many exclusions have an effective date in that year or range, counted over the whole list, not a page — answers "how many NC Medicaid exclusions took effect in 2025". The response names the date field counted (effective_date — NC Medicaid's own EFFECTIVE DATE column). Sourced from the NC Medicaid State Excluded Providers List, keyless.
name: nc_medical_exclusion_coverage
